title: Course enrolment feedback · keep the words, then group themes
subtitle: Six simulated observations; grouping is an analysis judgment, not a rate or root cause

observations.text: It is unclear what prior knowledge the course expects
The course page has no practice example
After payment, the next step is unclear
The class link is hard to find in the email
A screen reader cannot identify the buttons
An evening Q&A slot would help

assumptions: All content and source codes are original simulated data
Each observation belongs to one theme; minority marking does not duplicate it
No votes were collected and no priority is inferred
